edits.name: reedsR
edits.prompt: Repaint the first image as these two clumps of river reeds and bulrushes, in exactly the hand-painted storybook style of the reeds in the second image: soft painterly gouache shading, fine thin dark-brown linework, fresh green and straw leaves above. Below the wavy flood line every stem and leaf is soaked dark wet brown, glistening, dusted with fine pale silt specks; the colour change follows each stem with a darker wet edge where the water stood. Dark wet brown, never grey: no band, no collar, no ring across the clumps. Keep its shape and size. Keep the flat plain grey background around it, with empty grey space on every side.
